adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback logic for `updateEvent`/`deleteEvent` is self-contradictory: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. The `.find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (e.g. `undefined`), but then it searches for `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e. `=== undefined`), which will not match real calendar externalIds, so it returns `undefined`. This means update/delete can proceed without the intended calendarId selection (and downstream may fall back to "primary" or send `calendarId` undefined), risking failed updates/deletes and orphaned events when references lack `externalCalendarId`.
